For [filters](/docs/shell/commands/categories/filters/).

<div class='command-title'>Reverses the input list or table.</div>

## Command Type

`built-in`

## Signature

```> reverse {flags} ```


## Input/output types:

| input     | output    |
| --------- | --------- |
| list&lt;any&gt; | list&lt;any&gt; |
## Examples

Reverse a list.
```nu
> [0,1,2,3] | reverse
╭───┬───╮
│ 0 │ 3 │
│ 1 │ 2 │
│ 2 │ 1 │
│ 3 │ 0 │
╰───┴───╯

```

Reverse a table.
```nu
> [{a: 1} {a: 2}] | reverse
╭───┬───╮
│ # │ a │
├───┼───┤
│ 0 │ 2 │
│ 1 │ 1 │
╰───┴───╯

```
